semantics: palette state as first-class procedural state: palette-index objects (0x05; immutable one-byte index planes, exact content identity), a mutable bounded palette table in G_t (0x06 pre-checkpoint records, SetPalette 0x2d whole replacement, PatchPalette 0x2e entry patches, strictly ascending and in-range), and per-instance palette bindings (0x08 checkpoint variant for frame-0 rendering; BindPalette 0x2f in intervals; palette 0 unbinds). Materialization resolves F = indices o entries(bound palette); a missing binding/palette is UnknownPalette and an index beyond the palette length is OutOfBounds (typed, deterministic). New limits max_palette_entries (256) and max_palettes (4096). Old streams parse unchanged (0x03 checkpoints, all prior tags).

accent_flag_1920x1080.content: whole-canvas window-UI index plane (title/sidebar/separators/body/status bar/cursor), accent entry alternates 200/60 each interval via one PatchPalette
accent_flag_1920x1080.note: one-time index-plane declaration (2073600 B) dominates total bytes; the 24 B/interval is the maintenance cost of re-mapping a 2M-sample region whose structure never changes

rotate_flag_1920x1080.content: whole-palette value rotation each interval (classic color drift): every pixel of every frame changes

flattening_tax_240x160.content: section-55 court on UI content: identical visual frames as (a) authored palette state and (b) rasterized then inverse-proceduralized (Phase G whole-frame encoder; no palette family yet)
flattening_tax_240x160.note: the measured cost of flattening palette structure into rasters; palette discovery in the raster encoder is Phase O/Q

static_palette_640x360.content: palette content established then 200 zero-transition intervals
static_palette_640x360.note: palette content at rest is free

test_count: tests/phase_j.rs (12) + tests/malformed.rs (9 new Phase-J hostile) + identity/accounting units; full gate: cargo fmt --check, cargo check --all-targets, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo test --all-features (143 tests, 0 failures, dev and release)
notes: Index validity and palette presence are enforced at materialization time (typed errors), never at parse time: the palette is authoritative at render time, mirroring the residual algebra's render-time checks.
Bindings die with their instances (ClearInstances); palettes persist for reuse.
Palette streams are trajectory-collapse fixpoints (rebuild path for palettes is Phase O).

Accounting: pre-checkpoint palette-table records are state_bytes (no longer always 0); palette-index object declarations are object_bytes with an informational index_object_bytes split (index samples are structural, not RAW fallback).
